user.title: Choose a base map
user.description:
This integration replaces the base map with a Chinese map provider. Tiles are fetched by the Home Assistant server with datum shift applied there, so all clients show identical maps.

Get a free Tianditu key at [lbs.tianditu.gov.cn](http://lbs.tianditu.gov.cn/) (choose the "browser" type); AMap/Tencent need no key.

data_description.api_key: Vector and image share the same key. Stored on the HA server only. Leave empty for non-Tianditu sources.
data_description.fix_china_offset: Chinese maps use GCJ-02/BD-09 while HA entities are WGS84. Enable to shift tiles back so roads and entities align (default on).
data_description.precise_offset: On: up to 4 upstream tiles per tile (most accurate). Off: single tile, saves CPU.

abort.single_instance_allowed: The base map is a global setting, only one instance is allowed.

error.invalid_key: The API key is invalid or expired.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the validation server.
